site_description: The Italian guide to myrmecology — identification, species catalog and expert network
hero_subtitle: The first comprehensive guide to Italian ants
identify_subtitle: Select morphological characters in any order to identify the genus.

home_hero_subtitle: The first interactive guide to Italian ants. Identify, explore and discover the ant fauna of Italy.
home_what_subtitle: Three tools for anyone studying, observing or simply wanting to learn about Italian ants.
home_card_identify_desc: Interactive multi-access key with error tolerance. Select the characters you observe and get matching genera.
home_card_browse_desc: Complete catalog of 39 genera and 75 species with AntWeb photographs, diagnostic characters and distribution.
home_card_experts_desc: Network of 9 Italian myrmecologists with academic profiles, publications and areas of specialization.
home_featured_subtitle: Some of the most representative genera of the Italian ant fauna.
home_how_subtitle: Three steps to identify an ant genus using the interactive key.
home_step1_desc: Examine the specimen with a hand lens or microscope. Note thorax shape, antennae, petiole and other morphological details.
home_step2_desc: Choose character states in the interactive key, in any order. The visual glossary helps you interpret them.
home_step3_desc: Compatible genera are ranked by score. Even with a few errors, the correct result stays visible.
home_cta_subtitle: The interactive key guides you step by step. You don't need to be an expert to start.
footer_cite: To cite: Mensa F.S. (2026). Formiche d'Italia. formicheditalia.it
about_hero_desc: Formiche d'Italia is the digital evolution of the FormiKey thesis, a research project dedicated to identifying Italian ants. The goal: making myrmecology accessible to everyone.
about_formikey_p1: FormiKey is a multi-access identification key for Italian ants, developed as a master's thesis by Francesco Simone Mensa. Unlike traditional dichotomous keys, FormiKey allows selecting morphological characters in any order and includes an error tolerance system.
about_formikey_p2: The character matrices were built from taxonomic literature and validated by Dr. Fabrizio Rigato (Civic Museum of Natural History of Milan), one of Italy's leading ant taxonomy experts.
about_formikey_thesis: The original thesis is not currently publicly available. For information, please contact the author.
about_tool_identify: Interactive multi-access key with error tolerance
about_tool_browse: 39 genera and 75 species with AntWeb specimen photos
about_tool_experts: Network of Italian myrmecologists with academic profiles
about_bio_francesco: Author of the FormiKey identification key and taxonomic data. Designed the morphological character matrices and curated the genus and species data for Italian ants.
about_bio_claude: Development of the website, platform, and interactive identification key. Implementation of the scoring system with error tolerance and information gain.
about_thanks_text: We thank Dr. Fabrizio Rigato (Civic Museum of Natural History of Milan) for validating the morphological matrices, and all Italian myrmecologists who have contributed to the knowledge of Italy's ant fauna.
about_source_formikey_desc: Original data from the research thesis
about_cta_desc: Formiche d'Italia is a growing project. If you're an Italian ant expert and want to contribute, claim your profile or contact us to suggest corrections.
